instructions.question: What overall sentiment does the tweet's author express or convey about its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Positive needs explicit enthusiasm, praise or celebration, or an achievement, win, new product feature, eagerly wanted outing, or tribute or vigil (even after a tragedy). Negative covers complaints, disappointment, anger, mockery, personal mishaps, and reports of violence, injuries or criminal charges. Neutral covers ads, bare check-ins, flat plans, watching or playing reports without praise, plain news, joking critique of a player, political opinions without insults, questions, mixed views and trivial gripes.

neutral.what: Ads, check-ins, flat plans, watching or playing reports; news with no harm or achievement; joking critique of players; political opinions; mixed views; trivial gripes.
examples: Goin to the Ed Sheeran concert Thursday and I haven't really listened to him lol #whatislife
Josh Hamilton the best 1st pitch player in baseball gets a slow hanging curveball down the middle & just looks at it. Lol
Kanye West is insane. He also may be a complete genius. But I still don't want him to be president. #VMAs #fb
neutral.cues: don't miss, register, I'm going to, who wants to, just watched, may, reportedly, scores, lol
neutral.not_for: Violence, injuries or charges (negative); achievements or explicit delight (positive).

positive.what: Excitement, praise, love or celebration; achievements, wins; new product features; wanted outings; tributes, vigils, support; fans mocking a rival.
examples: Can't wait to see you tomorrow at The Roxy!
Surprising my mom with AC/DC tickets for Wednesday. Just going to show up
Apple Watch now works with August`s designer smart lock #charlesmilander
positive.cues: can't wait, love, excited, great, should be fun, I really want to, 1st place, now works with, vigil, celebrating, !!
positive.not_for: Venue ads, 'I'm going to X' check-ins (neutral); sarcastic praise (negative).

negative.what: Sadness, anger, frustration, disappointment, insults, mockery, personal mishaps, and reports of violence, injuries or charges.
examples: still so sad I'm not going to Ed Sheeran the 25th :////
Day 2 stuck in the Taipei airport. Possibly going to LA to wait out the storm. Didn't think I'd make it to Cali for the 1st time this way
RT @user Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
negative.cues: sad, bored, tedious, stuck, hate, worst, pathetic, wtf, :/, :(, attack, injured, charged
negative.not_for: Joking critique of a player (neutral); tributes or vigils after tragedy (positive).
